rubric.role_summary: Experienced or senior full-stack individual contributor building and owning product features across frontend and backend for a hospitality marketplace.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Experienced or senior full-stack individual contributor building and owning product features across frontend and backend for a hospitality marketplace.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Professional software development experience building product features.
- Have experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if stronger in one.
- Have experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.
- Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with React Native.
- Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.
- Previous experience working remotely.
- Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.
- Have shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment; no exact number of years or specific degree is required.
- Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: France (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

source_quotes: This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:
If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.
If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

soft_requirements: Able to take an ambiguous problem through to a reliable production release while making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs.
Cares about code quality, testing, maintainability, production reliability, delivery and user impact.
Communicates clearly, collaborates without ego and works closely with Product and Design.
Is autonomous and reliable in a distributed team and knows when to seek context, feedback or support.
